ruleDefinitions.name: Stop Windows Service Via Sc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the stopping of a Windows service via the "sc.exe" utility

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "sc\.exe" OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ stop\\ .*"))
